question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Many people prefers a heavy breakfast to a heavy lunch.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb **"prefers"** with the plural subject **"Many people."**
 
• The verb should agree in number with the subject. **"People"** is a plural noun and should be paired with **"prefer"** instead of **"prefers."**
 
• The correct phrase should be **"Many people prefer a heavy breakfast," **ensuring **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Many people **prefer** a heavy breakfast to a heavy lunch."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) Many people** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2) to a heavy lunch.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4) No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
